summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of Venture Ferret Core Engine. All 15 backend pytest cases passed (health, categories, stats, graph nodes/filter/detail/404, semantic/keyword/hybrid retrieval, governance, workflows, runs, live pipeline trigger+poll). Frontend console tested across all 5 views (Operations, Topology, Retrieval, Timeline, Governance). Live pipeline triggered from UI completed end-to-end in ~10s producing 2 nodes from example.com. Retrieval UI returns 8 semantic + 8 hybrid results with similarity & combined scores. No errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: VentureFerretConsole.jsx is 900 lines — consider splitting each view (OperationsView, TopologyView, RetrievalView, TimelineView, GovernanceView) into separate files for maintainability.
list_runs in routes/venture_ferret.py O(N) groups all events client-side (limit=500). For scale, add an aggregation pipeline or dedicated `research_runs` collection indexed by run_id.
MongoBackend.search_vector loads up to 500 candidates and computes cosine in Python — fine for fallback, but flag as the obvious bottleneck once Supabase pgvector is restored.

Endpoints /api/research/trigger and search endpoints lack request size/rate limiting — Firecrawl + Gemini calls cost money and an unauthenticated POST could be abused (system is documented as internal-only, so acceptable for MVP).
Supabase service_role key is empty in .env causing intentional Mongo fallback (per design). Once user provides a valid key, get_storage() will switch automatically — already validated by code path.
seed_data_creation: Pipeline triggers during testing added ~2 nodes for https://example.com (TEST_ prefixed queries). Final state: 8 knowledge nodes, 8 edges, 33 events, 8 actions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_venture_ferret.py runs in ~14s and covers all critical endpoints. Pipeline trigger test uses https://example.com to stay <30s. Retrieval UI input testid is 'retrieve-query' (NOT 'input-query' — that one is only on Operations view). Other key testids: nav-{ops|graph|retrieve|timeline|governance}, btn-trigger, btn-search, mode-{semantic|keyword|hybrid}, cat-filter-{all|infrastructure|...}, node-card-{id}, result-row-{idx}, run-row-{id}, step-row-{name}-{idx}, timeline-row-{i}, action-row-{i}. Storage backend currently MongoDB (Supabase service_role key empty — by design).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. One self-correction during testing: initial Playwright run used wrong selector 'input-query' on the retrieval view (correct is 'retrieve-query'), which caused empty fills and 0 results. Re-ran with correct selector and confirmed 8/8 results for semantic + hybrid.
